notes.title: USG V2.1??
notes.content:
Additions:
- Dynamic music based on how much health everyone has, the music sucks but atleast the thought was there.
- You can turn off the garbage music in a new settings menu! You can also turn off the sound effects.
- Controller works in menus now!
- Changed the layout of the menu a little.
- Fixed bugs.

Deletions:
- The 4-6 hours it took to make the update.

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.content:
If you haven't played Untitled Space Game yet now is the time. The new tutorial is designed to help new players grasp the mechanics of the game. 

Also the new item names should help clear up confusion over what the different items and weapons do.

If you haven't left a review please consider doing so as any feedback can help me improve the game.

Have fun and happy playing! :)
